feed.headline: Azerbaijan agrees multi-billion-dollar deals with investment giants
feed.ai: Nearly $11 billion (€9.7 billion) worth in contracts have emerged from the Azerbaijan International Investment Forum, where some of the world’s biggest investment managers gathered for talks ranging from infrastructure and technology to energy and transport.

feed.headline: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
feed.ai: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

feed.headline: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
feed.ai: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

feed.headline: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
feed.ai: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the measures as "common-sense tools that do not divide but really help to integrate".

feed.headline: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on Russian billionaire
feed.ai: Martin Ryan is pardoned months after he was jailed on charges of spying, but a second Frenchman remains in prison.

feed.headline: Netanyahu calls Macron's remarks on West Bank in UN speech 'grotesque'
feed.ai: Israel's PM denounces the French president after he appeared to downplay Hamas's activities in the occupied territory.

feed.headline: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
feed.ai: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

feed.headline: Italy Moves to Cap Number of Foreign Students in Its Classrooms
feed.ai: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said the goal was to better integrate non-Italian speaking children, but critics accused her of trying to appease anti-immigrant sentiment.

feed.headline: EU tells countries to curb energy demand as gas prices face winter squeeze
feed.ai: Although the EU is not facing immediate gas shortages, Energy Commissioner Jørgensen warned capitals that soaring prices driven by rising global demand could lead to shortages as winter approaches, according to a letter seen by Euronews.

feed.headline: In a Race With China, German Robots Are Outnumbered 14 to 1
feed.ai: A decade after the sale of Germany’s Kuka, Europe is seeking to shift into a higher gear to unlock the potential in robotics and artificial intelligence.

feed.headline: Europe Warns of Russia’s Hybrid Attacks but Struggles to Counter Them
feed.ai: If President Vladimir V. Putin was hoping to get Europeans’ attention, he’s succeeded with a series of close-call incursions. The question now is what they will do about it.

feed.headline: Europe Today: Trump's state dinner for Xi Jinping, Pope Leo's first visit to France
feed.ai: Trump and Xi Jinping's high-stakes Washington summit was closely watched in Europe, as Pope Leo XIV arrives in France for the first time. Also on the show: an interview with Danish minister Martin Lidegaard on the US-Denmark deal on Greenland and an update on the Ceuta migration crisis.
